releaseNotes.zh-CN: Windows 设置助手首次发布到模块分支，包含自动更新策略控制与原配置恢复、三种网络的防火墙配置，以及 BFE/MpsSvc 服务检查和经确认授权后的修复。默认应用使用可增删、搜索和多选的管理表，预置 22 种常用格式；可保存逐项目标程序、批量注册候选，并在模块启动后检查变化、按选项自动准备恢复。实际改变默认应用仍需在 Windows 设置中确认，不改写 UserChoice，也未实现打开方式代理。界面跟随宿主主题与字体，系统修改单独请求管理员授权，包含备份、冲突检查及操作日志。
releaseNotes.en-US: First branch publication of Windows Settings Assistant. Manage and restore Windows update policies and per-network firewall settings; inspect BFE/MpsSvc and attempt service repair only after explicit confirmation and elevation. A persistent, searchable association table includes 22 common formats, custom rows, multi-selection, per-format executable targets, batch candidate registration and optional startup drift checks/preparation. Windows confirmation is still required to change defaults; UserChoice is never rewritten and no file-opening proxy is included. Follows host appearance and fonts, with separate elevation, configuration backups, conflict checks and operation logs.
